categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` so that write exceptions do not trigger secondary exceptions during destructor unwinding.
categories.rationale: Prevents `std::terminate` process aborts by making `BufferedWriter::flush()` safe during exception unwinding. As described, failing flushes previously left pending bytes in the buffer, causing the destructor to throw a second exception.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to catch write errors in `BlockManager::WriteBlock` and `WriteBlockUndo`.
categories.rationale: Ensures disk write failures trigger standard storage error handling and clean shutdown instead of crashing the process. Reproduction showed `bitcoind` previously aborted on short writes rather than logging storage failures and exiting cleanly.
